When injecting EEH errors the port is getting hung up waiting on the node
list to empty
column2: message number 0233. The driver is stuck at this point and

column1: also can't unload. The driver makes transport remoteport delete calls which
try to abort I/O's
column2: but the EEH daemon has already called the driver to

column1: detach and the detachment has set the global FC_UNLOADING flag.  There are
several code paths that will avoid I/O cleanup if the FC_UNLOADING flag is
set
column2: resulting in transports waiting for I/O while the driver is waiting on

column1: transports to clean up.
Additionally
column3: a locking issue was found in

column1: lpfc_sli_abort_iocb_ring that could corrupt the list.
A special case was added to the lpfc_cleanup() routine to call
lpfc_sli_flush_rings() if the driver is FC_UNLOADING and if the pci-slot
is offline (e.g. EEH).
The SLI4 part of lpfc_sli_abort_iocb_ring() is changed to use the
ring_lock.  Also added code to cancel the I/Os if the pci-slot is offline
and added checks and returns for the FC_UNLOADING and HBA_IOQ_FLUSH flags
to prevent trying to send an I/O that we cannot handle.
